About.title: About Learn & Play
About.subtitle: A free learning app made with love for Class 5 students of Sindh.
About.missionText: Every child should enjoy learning in the languages of their home. Learn & Play mixes quizzes, flashcards and a friendly chatbot so students can practise English, Urdu and Sindhi — and learn about Pakistan and Sindh — while having fun.
About.schoolText: Learn & Play was created for the Class 5 students and teachers of {school} in Sindh, Pakistan. The questions and words match what children learn in Class 5, and any school can use it for free.
About.feature1: 75 quiz questions in five subjects, with three levels
About.feature2: 8 picture lessons with more than 100 words in three languages
About.feature3: Saathi, an offline chatbot that translates, counts and tells facts
About.feature4: Badges, a leaderboard and a progress chart to stay motivated
About.languagesText: Sindhi is the mother tongue of many of our students, Urdu is our national language, and English opens doors to the world. Seeing a word in all three helps children connect what they already know with what they are learning.
About.privacyText: There are no accounts and no ads. Everything — scores, lessons and chats — stays on this device. The app even works without internet once it has been opened.
About.teachersText: Open the app on a classroom projector, choose a quiz and let the class answer together. Use the lessons for short daily vocabulary practice.
